positions.title: Flight Test Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Composed and revised flight test plans for individual systems of the aircraft to be followed by the test pilots and programmed in-flight displays to assist the pilots during test flights
• Wrote comprehensive flight test reports to be submitted to the FAA to demonstrate the aircraft successfully met the appropriate federal regulations during testing
• Organized meetings with test pilots and engineers from various groups within the company to discuss flight test results and develop plans for more effective future test flights
• Developed a Microsoft Excel program using Visual Basic for Applications that integrates data from multiple flight test databases and tracks the progress of plans and reports for each aircraft system

positions.title: Engineering Technician Intern
positions.description:

• Performed quantity takeoff of lengths, areas, and volumes of various materials by analyzing the CAD files with AGTEK software and composed reports in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
